messages:
incident-bot: Pager: billing.metering.token_drift detected in eu1: token_count delta > 12% vs baseline, overage flags tripped for a subset of accounts. Severity: P2. Link: https://perf/alerts/7987654321
sre-oncall: ack — jumping in. Any customer-facing alerts?
prod-alerts: sent 3 customer alerts (billing_overage) for tenant ids t-12,t-34,t-99; hold/delete?
billing-eng: seeing delayed ingest from kafka consumer group consumption lag ~120k msgs. Counts later double-emitted when reprocessing kicks in.
ingest-eng: consumer lag spike started ~11:12 UTC after autoscaler bounced consumers. suspect duplicate commit path.
sre-oncall: can we mute overage notifications to customers while we investigate? cs-lead, need to hold alerts.
cs-lead: yes please mute, open a template note to affected customers.
ops: muting outbound alerts now :white_check_mark:
billing-eng: running quick query —
```
SELECT tenant_id, count(*) as cnt
FROM usage.events
WHERE ts >= '2026-03-21T11:00:00Z'
GROUP BY tenant_id
ORDER BY cnt DESC
LIMIT 20;
```
billing-eng: sample shows replays for same message_ids with different offsets. Logs: "replay_detected, msg_id=420, origin=eu1-consumer-3"
ingest-eng: pushing a patch to stop the duplicate reprocessor (hotfix) — rolling to eu1-consumer-3 (canary)
sre-oncall: watch for token_count settling, set threshold check.
incident-bot: metric snapshot: token_count.rate +14% over baseline; emitter.retries +8%; kafka.consumer_lag eu1=120012
ingest-eng: canary successful, duplicate emissions stopped on canary node. scaling down remaining consumers for controlled restart.
billing-eng: starting a reconciliation job to dedupe for last 40 minutes, will mark replays and backfill corrected counts.
cs-lead: draft message ready, will send once we have ETA on fully reconciled usage. customers impacted: 3 non-enterprise orgs, small overage flags only.
sre-oncall: plan: 1) mute alerts 2) stop reprocessor 3) restart consumers with proper commit offsets 4) run dedupe backfill 5) restore alerts and notify. ETA initial fix 15-20m.
ops: restarting consumers now (rolling).
prod-alerts: alerts remain muted.
billing-eng: dedupe job running, estimate 12m to complete.
ingest-eng: observed token_count delta decreasing to +2% now. nice.
sre-oncall: great. once dedupe completes, run a smoke check: compare token counts to shadow_agg for sample tenants.
billing-eng: smoke check script: diff_count = SELECT sum(corrected) - sum(reported) FROM ...; running.
incident-bot: update: dedupe done at 7987654390, corrected tokens -13,452 across affected tenants.
cs-lead: sending customer note now. attaching summary and assurances, offering credits if small overcharge occurred.
sre-oncall: lift mute on alerts after confirmation? ops, proceed to unmute after CS sent.
ops: unmuted prod alerts :white_check_mark:
billing-eng: post-run reconciliation complete, no long-term overcharge; will monitor overnight.
cs-lead: customers acknowledged, no escalations.
sre-oncall: closing thread in 30m unless new regressions. Thanks all.
alice: thanks team :heart:
